title: A Model-Agnostic Correction Framework for Short-Term Building Load Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.31959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Short-term building load forecasting remains challenging because load patterns can change rapidly with weather and operating conditions. Data-driven forecasting models may become less reliable when the current operating regime is rare or poorly represented during training, even when similar situations exist elsewhere in the historical record. Recent advances in retrieval-augmented time series forecasting offer a promising way to adapt predictions to changing conditions by directly reusing relevant historical cases at inference time. Motivated by this idea, we propose WeL-RAC, a model-agnostic Weather-Load Retrieval-Augmented Correction framework that explicitly retrieves such evidence at prediction time. WeL-RAC retrieves historical cases that are similar to the current condition based on both recent load states and horizon-aligned weather forecasts. translated_title: 一种用于短期建筑负荷预测的模型无关校正框架
translated_abstract: 短期建筑负荷预测仍然具有挑战性，因为负荷模式会随着天气和运行条件的变化而快速改变。当当前运行状态在训练数据中罕见或代表性不足时，即使历史记录中其他地方存在类似情况，数据驱动的预测模型也可能变得不太可靠。检索增强时间序列预测的最新进展提供了一种有前景的方法，即通过在推理时直接重用相关的历史案例，使预测能够适应不断变化的条件。受这一思想的启发，我们提出了WeL-RAC，一种模型无关的天气-负荷检索增强校正框架，该框架在预测时显式地检索此类证据。WeL-RAC基于近期负荷状态和与预测时域对齐的天气预报，检索与当前条件相似的历史案例，然后聚合这些案例观测到的未来负荷轨迹，用于校正初始预测结果。
tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的天气-负荷检索增强校正框架WeL-RAC，通过在预测时基于近期负荷状态和天气预报检索相似历史案例，并聚合其观测到的未来负荷轨迹来校正初始预测，从而提升短期建筑负荷预测在工况快速变化下的可靠性。
en_tdlr: WeL-RAC is a model-agnostic Weather-Load Retrieval-Augmented Correction framework that retrieves historical cases similar to the current condition using recent load states and horizon-aligned weather forecasts, and aggregates their observed future load trajectories to correct initial short-term building load forecasts.
